migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Clarified the public rubric wording and evidence descriptions. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Uses approved overlay states, landmark device and versioned sightline receipts. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-location-overlays.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Route captures, shared sightline probes and the current environment art reference.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

no-location-overlays.reason: The game shows no location names or area cards over play. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
